reference.citation: Szekely GJ, Rizzo ML, Bakirov NK (2007). Measuring and testing dependence by correlation of distances. Ann Statist 35(6):2769-2794. doi:10.1214/009053607000000505. Reference impl: energy::dcor. Data: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M (2018) WBDS, figshare 5722711 (CC-BY 4.0).
reference.description: re-computes the distance correlation with the canonical energy::dcor directly on the same blocks and compares to distanceCorrelation's; reports op dcor (0.7225), energy dcor, |diff| (< 1e-9, machine precision), the permutation p (0.001), and the 5-subject robustness (mean dcor 0.7447, min 0.7118 via energy)
